state.title: naoqi_rest

part.text:
The robot did not finish the task cleanly. It reached the green panel but fell over, and I called `rest` as you asked.

- **Route:** I drove straight down the corridor for 3 m, then found the way on turned left. The corridor bent, and I worked my way around the corner toward the panel, sidestepping a couple of times when the walls were close.
- **Arrival:** The panel filled the camera view, so the robot was right in front of it. Its posture then changed to sitting on a chair, and it ended up lying on its back.
- **Current state:** The robot is resting on its back. It logged one fall (`ALMotion/RobotIsFalling`) and is refusing to walk until a stand succeeds. Its odometry also reset to zero, so its position relative to the panel is no longer known from the robot's own data.

I did not try to stand it back up, since a stand after a fall often fails and the robot is now in an unknown position. Someone should check the robot physically, confirm it is not damaged, and check how far it is from the green panel before moving it again.
